26/* @brief Base class for robot actuators.
27 *
28 * Mirrors @ref ControllerBase and @ref SensorBase: derives from ComponentBase for common lifecycle
29 * (validity, actor, destroy). No concrete actuators exist yet; this establishes the contract early
30 * so the first actuator follows the same shape as controllers and sensors.
31 *
32 * Registration contract (a RoboticsContext::RegisterActuator<T> template lands with the first
33 * concrete actuator, mirroring RegisterController/RegisterSensor): every actuator must declare
34 * static constexpr std::string_view TypeName() { return "..."; }
35 * (used by the registration templates and for the generated Python type_name() binding), implement
36 * std::string_view GetTypeName() const override; // returns TypeName()
37 * and provide a uniform constructor
38 * ActuatorX(Actor* actor, std::string_view paramArgs, Error& error);
39 * that loads its own params from the path or inline JSON. An (Actor*, Params const&, Error&)
40 * overload is recommended for programmatic / non-filesystem construction.
41 *
42 * Teardown contract (mirrors @ref ControllerBase / @ref SensorBase): @ref GetActor() resolves the
43 * live actor on demand and yields nullptr once the owning mochi Scene (or the actor) is gone, so an
44 * actuator that outlives its Scene (Scene destroyed before the RoboticsContext) sees @ref
45 * GetActor() == nullptr in its destructor. Any concrete actuator whose destructor releases
46 * actor-held resources must therefore guard on @ref GetActor() != nullptr (or, for context-owned
47 * resources, resolve via
48 * @ref GetContext()) so teardown never dereferences a dangling Actor*. */
49// NOLINTNEXTLINE(cppcoreguidelines-virtual-class-destructor)
50class MOCHI_API ActuatorBase : public ComponentBase {
51 public:
52 /* @brief Reset internal state between episodes, keeping params. Pure virtual so every actuator
53 * states its answer explicitly: a stateful actuator that silently inherited a no-op would leave
54 * stale state alive across a reset, which is only discoverable in the collected data. An actuator
55 * that holds no per-episode state implements this as an empty body. */
56 void Reset() override = 0;
57
58 protected:
59 /* @brief Common actuator constructor archetype: stores the actor via ComponentBase and validates
60 * it is non-null. Every actuator delegates to this, then loads its own params. */
61 ActuatorBase(Actor* actor, superdex::Error& error) : ComponentBase(actor) {
62 MOCHI_ERROR_IF(actor == nullptr, error, "ActuatorBase: actor is null");
63 }
64 ~ActuatorBase() override;
65};
